subject: Staged upsell, co-terming, and auto-renew safety-net
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staged upsell, co-terming, and auto-renew safety-net

Jordan — thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached are two artifacts to discuss a staged upsell that aligns with AcmeHealth's FY boundary and minimizes procurement friction: a short amendment (RA_Amendment_v2.pdf) and a draft onboarding SOW (SOW_onboarding.xlsx). High-level proposal below:

- Structure: 2-year term, Year 1 reserved capacity (committed) + burst pool; Year 2 is baked as a committed uplift contingent on hitting onboarding and Q1 usage milestones.
- Co-terming: if you want to align to your 3/31 fiscal boundary, we propose a pro-rated stub period on signing, then co-term to 3/31 next year.
- Auto-renew safety-net: standard 12-month auto-renew but with a 60-day opt-out window and a one-time 30% ramp holdback in month 1 to protect unit economics until usage stabilizes.
- Financials: discount ladder tied to committed throughput and milestone unlocks (see amendment). We anticipate a 15% effective discount in Year 2 conditional on usage thresholds being met.
- Operational asks: an initial onboarding kickoff within 30 days of signature; production readiness checklist owned by Acme with Redwood support.

Quick asks for you: 1) Is the co-term to 3/31 workable from procurement? 2) Any constraints on auto-renew language (we can add explicit opt-out mechanics for procurement)? 3) Are the milestone windows acceptable (onboarding completion + 90-day usage checkpoint)?

If that looks reasonable I'll schedule a short call with Marissa (billing/contract) and Camila (onboarding) to walk through redlines.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Principal Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RA_Amendment_v2.pdf (application/pdf, stub); SOW_onboarding.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, stub)

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acmehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staged upsell, co-terming, and auto-renew safety-net

Thanks, Soojin — appreciate the concise plan. A few quick clarifying Qs from procurement and our finance team:

1) Auto-renew: we need explicit language that allows us to decline renewal with 45 days' notice rather than 60. Can you accept 45?
2) Proration/Co-term: if we co-term to 3/31 and sign in May, how is the stub billed? Is it full month billing or pro-rated by day? We prefer day pro-ration.
3) Ramp holdback: need clear SLO/usage definitions before we accept a 30% holdback on month 1 — what triggers release?
4) Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence is in progress on your side; procurement will need a timeline and an attestation letter.

Overall the commercial structure is promising — we just need those items clarified before we circulate to legal. Can Marissa or Camila provide the suggested wording for opt-out periods and the proration approach? Also a sample DocuSign flow would help accelerate internal sign-off.

Best,
Jordan
Head of Platform Engineering
AcmeHealth

Looping internal ops — forwarding Jordan's procurement items and my suggested playbook responses below. We'll send anything external-ready from Legal/Billing, but want to align on the operational levers first.

Quoted from Jordan's note:
> 1) Auto-renew: we need explicit language that allows us to decline renewal with 45 days' notice rather than 60. Can you accept 45?
> 2) Proration/Co-term: if we co-term to 3/31 and sign in May, how is the stub billed? Is it full month billing or pro-rated by day? We prefer day pro-ration.
> 3) Ramp holdback: need clear SLO/usage definitions before we accept a 30% holdback on month 1 — what triggers release?
> 4) Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence is in progress on your side; procurement will need a timeline and an attestation letter.

My recommended responses (for Soojin to send to Jordan):
- Auto-renew: agree to 45-day opt-out (we'll edit amendment language).
- Proration/Co-term: accept day-level proration for the stub period; billing will show a prorated invoice and the remainder co-terming to 3/31.
- Ramp holdback: release tied to a simple two-part gate: onboarding completion (signed-off checklist by Camila) AND a 90-day average usage >= 60% of committed baseline. When both satisfied, the 30% holdback releases in the next billing cycle. We can add an SLO credit schedule if Marching toward noncompliance.
- SOC2: security should provide an attestation letter and target sending within 5 business days; Camila, can you coordinate with SecOps to get the attestation PDF?

Next steps I propose: I will draft the redline to RA_Amendment_v2 (commercial/legal-friendly) — Soojin please confirm and then I'll route to Jordan + procurement. Camila to prepare the onboarding checklist and the SOC2 attestation stub for the procurement queue.

Marissa
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

--

Subject: Re: Staged upsell, co-terming, and auto-renew safety-net — next steps

Jordan — thanks for the questions and for looping procurement. Confirming the commitments below so procurement/legal has a single doc to review: 

1) Auto-renew opt-out: Redwood accepts a 45-day opt-out window. Amendment will be updated to reflect this language.
2) Stub proration: we will apply day-level proration for any stub period when co-terming to 3/31; invoice will show prorated stub line item.
3) Ramp holdback: release conditions are (a) onboarding checklist signed by Acme (Camila lead) and (b) a 90-day average usage >= 60% of committed baseline. When both gates are met the holdback releases on the next invoice cycle. We will include an SLO credit schedule in the amendment as a protective measure.
4) SOC2 attestation: Camila has confirmed SecOps will deliver an attestation letter within 5 business days; we'll attach to the DocuSign packet.

Next operational items: 
- Marissa will circulate a redlined amendment for signature (DocuSign link included below).
- Camila will share the onboarding checklist and a preliminary invoice cadence (30/60/90 day stub + monthly thereafter).
- Proposed next call: Tue Apr 20 at 10:00am PT to review redlines and the SOW. Let me know if that works.

DocuSign (preview): https://www.docusign.com/link/ACME-1245-amendment
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ACME-1245

If procurement/legal want to make edits directly to the amendment, we can accept tracked PDF redlines prior to DocuSign. I'll attach RA_Amendment_v2.pdf and the SOW_onboarding.xlsx for your procurement queue.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this week.

Soojin Lee
